ModMetaData.name: Autonomous Colonists (Experimental)
ModMetaData.author: Community prototype
ModMetaData.description: Independent experimental work-priority manager for RimWorld 1.7 (.NET 10). Opt-in automatic coverage based on skills, passions and available capacity, with stable specialist assignments, backups, manual-edit protection, per-pawn exclusions and conditional restoration. Never enables priority-zero work or changes forced jobs, medical settings, food, rest, apparel or schedules. Pauses when Work Manager is active. Built against user-provided 1.7 libraries; actual game and Android validation pending. Read INSTALAR.md before testing.
